summary: Reproduced all 13 direct detect_and_parse text-loss cases and changed the affected detectors to return the original response whenever marker recognition yields zero parsed calls. A related open upstream PR (https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/35636) fixes only the FunctionCallParser serving wrapper and does not satisfy the issue's direct detector reproducer.

tests.command: issue-provided direct detect_and_parse reproducer on base commit
tests.what_was_measured: All 13 parsers returned empty normal_text and zero calls; retained in reproduction-before.txt.

tests.command: issue-provided direct detect_and_parse reproducer after patch
tests.what_was_measured: All 13 parsers preserved their input marker text with zero calls; retained in reproduction-after.txt.
350 tests and 20 subtests passed, including the 13-parser regression and independent plain-text, prefixed-incomplete, complete-call, and invalid-JSON boundaries.

remaining_limitations: No HTTP model-serving reproduction was run because the reported failure is below transport/model execution and is directly reproducible without weights.
No GPU execution was performed because it would not exercise a different path for this parser-only defect.
The related upstream PR 35636 remains open; this delivery does not modify or notify upstream.
